---
title: Ziti with Tomato and Tuna
id: MAR-0117
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 40
difficulty: easy
---
## Ingredients
- 320 g of ziti
- 150 g of tuna in oil
- 1 onion
- 1 garlic clove
- 4 anchovy fillets in oil
- 400 g of tomatoes
- 2 tablespoons of extra virgin olive oil
- to taste salt
## Method
1. Peel the onion and garlic and chop them.
2. Blanch the tomatoes in lightly salted water for about 30 seconds, then drain them, peel them, cut them into quarters, remove the seeds, and cut the remaining pulp into pieces.
3. Break up the tuna.
4. Sauté the garlic and onion in a pan with the oil; after 5 minutes, dissolve the chopped anchovy fillets over very low heat, then add the tomatoes and let cook for 20 minutes.
5. Add the tuna and continue cooking for another 5 minutes.
6. Meanwhile, break the ziti and cook them in boiling salted water; drain them, pour them into the pan with the tuna, mix, and serve.
